title: Планы, привычки и формы глагола
description: Различаем распространённые сочетания глаголов с -ing и to-infinitive без изменения смысла.
notes: После enjoy и avoid используется форма -ing.
После decide и hope используется to + начальная форма; это модель конкретного глагола.

options.label: I enjoy to learn new skills.

exercises.explanation: Enjoy требует learning в этой конструкции.

exercises.prompt: Дополни предложение подходящим словом или краткой формой.

exercises.editorial_answer: She avoids driving during rush hour.

public_payload.sentence: He suggested to take a short break.

accepted: He suggested taking a short break.

exercises.reference_answer: He suggested taking a short break.
exercises.incorrect_answer: He suggested to take a short break.
exercises.editorial_answer: He suggested taking a short break.
exercises.explanation: После suggested здесь нужна форма taking.

accepted: I hope to find a new job.
I am hoping to find a new job.

exercises.reference_answer: I hope to find a new job.
exercises.incorrect_answer: I enjoy finding a new job.
exercises.editorial_answer: I hope to find a new job.
exercises.explanation: Hope to find передаёт надежду; enjoy обозначает удовольствие.

exercises.prompt: Почему Джон выбрал работу в поддержке?

options.label: He wanted to avoid communicating with colleagues.
He enjoyed helping people with technical problems.
He had already been offered a job by his friend.

public_payload.passage: Jon wanted to change jobs, but he was unsure where to begin. A friend suggested making a list of the tasks he enjoyed doing. Jon realised that he liked helping colleagues solve technical problems and avoided working alone for long periods. He decided to apply for a support role and hoped to find a team that valued patient communication.

exercises.editorial_answer: He enjoyed helping people with technical problems.
exercises.explanation: Его интерес к помощи людям соответствует выбранной роли.

options.label: I suggest to sending the agenda in advance.
I suggest send the agenda in advance.
I suggest sending the agenda in advance.

lines.speaker: Colleague
lines.text: How can we make our meetings shorter?

exercises.editorial_answer: I suggest sending the agenda in advance.

exercises.prompt: Выбери форму после looking forward to.

public_payload.sentence: I'm looking forward to ___ the new team.

exercises.explanation: To здесь предлог в устойчивом выражении, поэтому после него -ing.
